acceptance: Decision gate: fix in the tractable repository and release; BenchBox then takes the new wheel through its normal tracker runtime bump. Do not patch the vendored wheel.
Verification: a tractable test sets a future not_before, clears it with an empty value, and takes the item immediately.
Done when the fixed release is pinned in BenchBox, or the documentation is corrected and that release is pinned.
description:
Found on 2026-11-11 while delivering retro-navigation-fixes-umbrella-20261111 (or in the retrospective over 25 agent sessions that preceded it) and not addressed there.

Cross-repository item (joeharris76/tractable), tracked here because BenchBox drives the tracker.

Problem. The server instructions and the update_item tool description say `not_before=""` clears a hold. On tractable 1.0.0, `update_item {"id": <item with waiting_until set>, "not_before": ""}` returns `E_STATE: operation produced no state change` and the hold stays; sent together with `context_append`, only the context changes. Observed five times on 2026-11-11 on open, unclaimed items. Workaround used: set not_before a few seconds in the future, wait, then take.

Change. Make the empty value clear the hold as documented, or change the documentation and name the supported way.
